title: Quenched Juicy Portuguese Monkfish Skillet
description: A charred and juicy Portuguese dish featuring monkfish, this recipe is a monsoon of flavors in a single skillet, perfect for a paleo-friendly dinner option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and onion to the skillet and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the bell peppers to the skillet and cook until they start to char.
Add the monkfish fillets to the skillet and cook for 4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Sprinkle the paprika, salt, and black pepper over the monkfish and bell peppers.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the skillet for 5 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve the skillet hot.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
